value.rationale: The smallest three-regular Boolean cube naturally crosses three connectivity regimes at palettes 3,4,5. A uniform eccentricity of 12 in the entire mobile sector throughout this transition is not forced by the prior global diameter theorem and the exact all-pair distance distribution provides a reproducible metric benchmark and a sharp finite boundary example for reconfiguration investigations.
